Its proposed HCP-domain and dislocation-core mechanism remains weakly supported, but A is less physically credible because Cr is not a plausible promoter of a ductile FCC phase in NbMoTaW, B2 is not inherently ductile, and its own evidence warns that Cr-rich precipitation can cause embrittlement.
